'''Delta Squad''' was a military unit of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Battle of Ilum]], they were sent to disable the [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shield]] protecting the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] base [[Fort Salvo]], but failed and were wiped out.<ref name="TOR-SUD" />
